items.name: Vårmure
items.observations: Illustrated original of Potentilla verna (spring cinquefoil), not a Galium maure. Five separate golden petals in each flower, several toothed palmate 5-foliolate leaves, hairy prostrate reddish stems and a low matted habit. Tested on black background after background-alpha cleanup.
items.limitations: Botanical illustration, not a photograph or voucher. Hair and root details simplified. Norwegian 2021 Red List VU; species must not be represented as common in Oslo.
